title: What's New in Shopify Connector: Prices for Markets (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: How Shopify Markets Handle Pricing and Currency
Market Catalog Import in Business Central
Point of Sale and B2B Market Options
B2B Catalogs and Currency Code Field

features.name: Market Catalog Import
features.description: New page called market catalog that imports catalogs from Shopify markets. Users can retrieve and link Shopify catalogs to Business Central, showing market names, linked markets, and currency codes.
caveats: Requires Business Central in appropriate version
Works with existing Shopify market setup

features.name: Price Synchronization for Markets
features.description: Sync prices button that synchronizes product prices from Shopify market catalogs to Business Central customer price groups based on market and currency configuration.

features.name: Multi-currency Market Support
features.description: Support for different currencies per market. Catalogs can be linked to multiple markets with different currencies, and Business Central displays currency codes for each catalog based on market definition.
caveats: Local currency displays as blank code in Business Central

features.name: Point of Sale Market Definition
features.description: Ability to define markets for point of sale locations. Users can specify POS locations when creating markets and assign prices per POS location.

features.name: B2B Catalog Company Locations
features.description: For B2B plus customers, ability to define market with company locations. Catalogs can be linked to specific company locations or directly to B2B customers.
caveats: Only for B for plus customers using B2B
Two options available: market company locations or direct customer linking

features.name: B2B Catalogs with Currency Code
features.description: Renamed B2B catalogs page (previously called Catalog). Now includes currency code field for each catalog, allowing B2B catalogs to have associated currencies.
caveats: Renamed from Catalog to B2B Catalogs
Works same as before with additional currency field
